name: Test MiniBob-TUI with Production Package
description: Verify MiniBob-TUI works correctly with @metabob/minibob production package from npm registry

outputShapes.description: Test execution results with pass/fail status
Markdown report of verification steps and outcomes

tasks.description: Verify @metabob/minibob is installed from npm registry (not local file reference)

prompt.template:
Check that node_modules/@metabob/minibob exists and is a real directory (not a symlink). Read package.json from that directory and verify the version matches what's declared in repos/minibob-tui/package.json. Report:
1. Whether it's a symlink or real directory
2. Installed version
3. Expected version from package.json
4. Whether they match

tasks.description: Verify all imports from production package resolve correctly
Execute automated demo script to verify all checks pass

prompt.template:
Run the demo script: `bash scripts/demo-minibob-tui.sh` from the project root.

The script will:
1. Verify production package installation
2. Test import resolution
3. Check for API keys
4. Show available test modes

Capture the output and report:
- How many checkmarks (✓) appeared
- Any errors or warnings (⚠ or ✗)
- Overall pass/fail status

tasks.description: Run TypeScript type checking and document any type errors

prompt.template:
Run `bun run typecheck` from repos/minibob-tui directory.

If there are type errors, analyze them and report:
1. Number of type errors
2. Common error patterns (e.g., property missing, type mismatch)
3. Whether errors are due to version mismatch (0.3.7 vs 0.4.0 API)
4. Whether errors are blocking for runtime functionality

Note: Some type errors are expected if production package version doesn't match local MiniBob version.
